name: append_nil_thm
statement: theorem append_nil_thm (xs : List Nat) : xs ++ [] = xs

name: reverse_reverse_thm
statement: theorem reverse_reverse_thm (xs : List Nat) : xs.reverse.reverse = xs

name: and_swap
statement: theorem and_swap (a b : Prop) (h : a ∧ b) : b ∧ a

name: or_swap
statement: theorem or_swap (a b : Prop) (h : a ∨ b) : b ∨ a

name: imp_chain
statement: theorem imp_chain (p q r : Prop) (hpq : p → q) (hqr : q → r) (hp : p) : r

name: imp_trans2
statement: theorem imp_trans2 (p q r s : Prop) (h1 : p → q) (h2 : q → r) (h3 : r → s) : p → s

name: or_assoc_thm
statement: theorem or_assoc_thm (a b c : Prop) (h : (a ∨ b) ∨ c) : a ∨ (b ∨ c)
